items.title: DoorDash (DASH) Stock Looks Overvalued Following Its 90% Three Year Run
items.summary: DoorDash is back in the spotlight after a mixed run in the share price and a headline acquisition plan. The live question is whether the current valuation can be justified by what the company earns today versus what it might earn in the future. Over the past 3 years, DoorDash shares have gained about 90.1%, which puts a lot of weight on the idea that the business can grow into the expectations now embedded in its valuation. items.title: Uber Becomes McDonald’s “Preferred Delivery Partner” in 14 Markets as Its DoorDash Fight Widens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMcDonald’s named Uber the preferred delivery partner for orders placed in its own app, as part of a multi-year expansion across 14 markets for a McDelivery business that brings in more than $20 billion a year. The deal comes days after another big-brand delivery deal, so Uber has now signed two of the biggest consumer brands while DoorDash works through its deal to buy Instacart.
